name: @rtemis/draw
description: ECharts option builders shared by rtemis.draw and rtemislive

scripts.build: pnpm clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm bundle
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=RtemisDraw --target=es2020 --legal-comments=inline --footer:js="if (typeof module === 'object' && module.exports) module.exports = RtemisDraw;" --outfile=dist/rtemis-draw-builders.cjs
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check && vitest run
